Class UpdateHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Network.UpdateHandler.UpdateHandler
public class UpdateHandler extends Object
The UpdateHandler class is responsible for managing and processing game state updates that are generated by the server. It utilizes multiple threads to handle updates, input commands, and forced transitions efficiently.

  • Method Details

    • processUpdate

      public void processUpdate(Answer answer)
      Processes an update based on the provided answer. The method handles the current and next states from the Answer object.
      Parameters:
      answer - the message received from the server containing the player's nickname, current state, and next state for model and UI updates

    • reportErrorUpdate

      public void reportErrorUpdate(ErrorAnswer error)
      Reports an error update by delegating the error message to the view updater. The error is processed asynchronously using the input thread.
      Parameters:
      error - the ErrorAnswer object containing the error details

    • acceptState

      private CompletableFuture<Void> acceptState(CompletableFuture<Void> future, StateDTO state, ExecutorService executor, String errorPrefix)
      This method will accept the state to invoke the visitor and make the state actions
      Parameters:
      future - the current flow future
      state - the state that will be used in the visitor
      executor - the thread where is desired to execute the visitor
      errorPrefix - the error prefix that is desired to input before the caught error msg

    • commitCmd

      private CompletableFuture<Void> commitCmd(CompletableFuture<Void> future, String nickname, ExecutorService executor)
      This method will try to commit the message sent to the server

      future - the current flow future
      nickname - the player nickname, stored in the Answer
      executor - the thread where is desired to execute the commit
